requirements.text: The accounting system must value exchange-traded FLEX option contracts daily at the official close using the model-based price provided by the exchange on which the options are principally traded.
requirements.source: FLEX Options listed on an exchange will typically be valued at a model-based price provided by the exchange at the official close of that exchange’s trading day.

requirements.text: If a FLEX option position has a same-day market trading price on the valuation date, the system must override the exchange model price and use the same-day market trade price to calculate NAV.
requirements.source: However, when the Fund’s option has a same-day market trading price, this same-day market trading price will be used for FLEX Option values instead of the exchange’s model-based price.

requirements.text: If the exchange cannot provide a model price, the system must use a model price from a backup third-party pricing provider; if both are unavailable, the position must be valued per Valuation Designee procedures.
requirements.source: If the exchange on which the option is traded is unable to provide a model price, model-based FLEX Options prices will additionally be provided by a backup third-party pricing provider.

requirements.text: If in the same trading day a FLEX Option is included in both an all-cash basket and an in-kind basket, the system must use the same-day trade price for valuation across both baskets.
requirements.source: In instances where in the same trading day, a particular FLEX Option is represented in an all-cash basket (either a creation unit or redemption unit), as well as in an in-kind basket (either a creation unit or a redemption unit), for valuation purposes that trading day the Fund will default to use the trade price for both instances, rather than the model price otherwise available for the in-kind transaction.

requirements.text: Purchased FLEX options must be recorded as investment assets at premium paid on trade date (T+0) and marked to market daily; written FLEX options must be recorded as liabilities at premium received and marked to market daily.
requirements.source: When the Funds purchase an option, an amount equal to the premium paid by the Funds are recorded as an investment and is subsequently adjusted to the current value of the option purchased... When the Funds write an option, an amount equal to the premium received by the Funds are recorded as a liability and is subsequently adjusted to the current value of the option written.

requirements.text: Option positions closing or expiring must be cash-settled against the Reference Asset's closing price at expiration, recognizing realized gains or losses based on identified cost basis.
requirements.source: The Trust determines the gain or loss realized from investment transactions on the basis of identified cost... Cash-settled option contracts give the holder the right to receive an amount (or owe an amount) of cash upon the exercise of the option contracts.

requirements.text: The fund accounting system must accrue the annual unitary management fee daily based on average daily net assets at a rate of 0.79% per annum using an actual/365 day count convention.
requirements.source: the Fund has agreed to pay an annual unitary management fee to Innovator in an amount equal to 0.79% of its average daily net assets.

requirements.text: Interest income on cash balances held in the Money Market Deposit Account (MMDA) must be accrued daily on an effective yield basis.
requirements.source: Interest income, including accretion of discounts and amortization of premiums is recognized on an accrual basis using the effective yield method.

requirements.text: For creation and redemption transactions, the system must process Creation Unit orders at NAV next determined after receipt, calculate the Cash Component balancing amount, and record transaction fees paid by Authorized Participants.
requirements.source: The Cash Component serves the function of compensating for any differences between the NAV per Creation Unit and the “Deposit Amount”... Creation Units are sold at their NAV plus a transaction fee.
